entries.title: Themes admin list showing Business Solutions.
entries.notes: Capture after installing capell-app/theme-business-solutions with Foundation Theme and capell-app/demo-kit in the isolated screenshot harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator sees the installed Business Solutions theme records in the host Themes admin surface.

entries.title: Admin content blocks editing unique business content.
entries.notes: Capture after capell-app/demo-kit has generated a business-theme demo page. Open the page layout/content editor and show the hero, proof, listing, or CTA content as normal editable content blocks rather than theme-owned hardcoded copy.
entries.useCase: An editor changes custom page-specific business copy in the admin while the selected theme controls only the public presentation.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with the Juris legal theme.
